purpose: Teach: マリオ/マーティン/スティーブン/コリン/ティム/アレックス/ニコラ/アーサー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスーパーマリオのゲームを一緒に遊んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to play Super Mario with you.
lines.style: Gentle, warm announcement. Soft opening. Steady, encouraging pace. A mother sharing a gift her son is about to receive. Small lift at the end—anticipation for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとマーティン・スコセッシ監督の映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a Martin Scorsese film with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager voice with a little burst of pride. Quick on 'watched'—he can't wait to tell her. Open and genuine. The joy of sharing something he experienced.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスティーブン・ホーキングのドキュメンタリー観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a Stephen Hawking documentary right now.
lines.style: Gentle observation, mildly amused undertone. Slower pace than the announcement. A soft recognition of what Dad is up to. Slight warmth—she notices, she accepts, she's almost smiling at it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとコリン・ファースの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a Colin Firth film with Dad!
lines.style: Quick, eager delivery. Same brightness as before but with slightly more force—he's building momentum. Proud of himself. Genuine delight spilling out.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがティム・バートン監督の特集番組観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a Tim Burton feature special right now.
lines.style: Calm, nearly amused. Measured pace. A knowing, gentle observation about what Dad is doing. The smallest hint of warmth—she's gotten used to this. Understands him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアレックス・ライダーの少年小説読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read an Alex Rider adventure novel with Dad!
lines.style: Quick, enthusiastic burst. The excitement of a younger child reaching for sophisticated things. Bright and earnest. Slightly breathless—he wants her to understand how special this was.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがニコラ・テスラの伝記映画観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a Nikola Tesla biographical film right now.
lines.style: Quiet amusement now apparent. Slow, gentle pace. The softest affection underneath—she's amused but also genuinely fond of his interests. A small pause before the final phrase, like she's savoring the thought of him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアーサー王伝説のアニメ観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched an Arthurian legend anime with Dad!
lines.style: Joyful and close—like he's leaning in to share something wonderful. Fast, eager delivery. Warmth and pride fully integrated. The sense of a special moment being reported, not just an activity.
